correctness.rationale: The displayed positive k-by-n matrix has row sums one, column sums k/n, and distinct rows. The standard basis vectors and added positive rows all have l1 norm one; the proposed functionals have dual norm one and norm their paired vectors. The standard contribution to the frame operator is (1+k/n)I-(k/n)J and the added rows contribute (k/n)J, leaving ((n+k)/n)I. Exact-rational replay verified positivity, margins, distinctness, norming, and every frame-operator entry for all 77 pairs with 2<=n<=12 and 1<=k<=n.

final_claim: For every \(n\ge2\) and every \(1\le k\le n\), real \(\ell_1^n\) has a FUNTF of length \(n+k\) whose primal frame vectors are pairwise distinct; in particular there is such a length-seven FUNTF in real \(\ell_1^5\).
limitations: The pairwise-distinct requirement is for the primal vectors; the claim does not require all norming functionals to be distinct.
An obscure post-2022 or unindexed construction could duplicate the same elementary prescribed-margin method.
